jwt.ph.input: Paste a token that looks like eyJhbGciOi…
jwt.label.head: Header — how it was signed
jwt.status.plain: A JWT is not encrypted — it is signed plain text. Anyone holding the token can read what is inside.
jwt.err.shape: That is not a JWT. It should be three pieces separated by dots.
jwt.err.decode: Could not decode the pieces. The token may be cut off or in a different format.
jwt.status.noExp: This token has no expiry (exp). Signature checking needs the secret key, so it is not done here.
jwt.status.valid: This token is still valid (the signature was not verified).
